{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, verify that there are no unexpected non-numeric formats
print("Unique values in revenue (before cleaning):")
print(data['revenue'].unique())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the cleaned revenue
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:")
print(data['revenue_clean'].head())

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
print("Number of rows with revenue_clean == 999999.99:", (data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", (data['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Remove refunded orders from analysis (as per documentation: they are not real revenue)
data_filtered = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the number of rows after filtering
print("Number of completed orders (after filtering):")
print(len(data_filtered))"}
